newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY 96 INFLATION ESTIMATE 23 PCT AVERAGE FOR YR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY 96 INFLATION ESTIMATE 23 PCT AVERAGE FOR YR.

text.p: The Hungarian government on Friday said its preliminary estimate for the average rate of inflation for 1996 was 23 percent, government spokesman Elemer Kiss said.
The rate is lower than the 28.2 percent average for 1995 but is higher than a target agreed with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) of 20 percent average for the year.
Inflation has registered a consistent slowdown during 1996, Kiss said.
